name: Amphisbaena Call, Lesser
body:
School conjuration; Level: serpent druid 4, serpent warlock 4, snake cultist leader 4, sorcerer/wizard/summoner 4, witch 4

Components: V, S, M (two snake heads carved from 100 gp emeralds)

Casting Time: 1 round

Target(s): Caster (see text)

Duration: 1 hour/2 caster levels

Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance: yes (harmless)

While this spell is in effect, the caster can give the amphisbaena serpent template to any snakes he then summons using the summon monster or summon nature’s ally I-V spells. It also extends the duration the summoned amphisbaena snakes can stay by 1 round per two caster levels.
